issues.on_page: Grant income/donations 11,153 (Street Special Revenue; Schedule 2 p10 prints 'Grant income'; Statement of Activities p2: Public works Capital Grants and Contributions 11,153)
issues.issue: The schedule row says 'Grant income' in the Street fund, so the money may come from a government (federal grants or intergovernmental) rather than private donations. Same question for detail[26].

The same label gets different categories in this report. The statement line and General Fund detail[7] are 'other', but Street detail[25] 1,375, Park detail[42] 425 and Water detail[81] 695 are 'charges for services/fees' (the Statement of Activities counts them as charges for services). Also, category_decisions.csv maps 'miscellaneous' to 'other' (apply=label), so user_rules.py will likely reset the detail lines.

issues.on_page: Other 17,653 (under 'Intergovernmental revenues' heading; General 9,730 p10 + Debt Service 7,923 p11)
issues.issue: The row is printed under the Intergovernmental revenues heading, so state aid fits the page. But category_decisions.csv maps the bare label 'other' to 'other' (apply=label), which may override it (also detail[5], detail[38]).
The extractor rules say Homestead Exemption is also its own detail_category ('Homestead Exemption'). Same for detail[37] (4,469).

issues.on_page: Water/Sewer Exhibit H lines by cost type (Salaries and wages, Repairs, Insurance, Office supplies, Utilities, Other, Supplies, Depreciation)
